classification_reason: With intact ledgers, idempotency semantics are correct: an identical resubmission replays (same transaction, no new file or receipt), even after the world moved on; a new key writes again; a key reused for a different payload is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; --replay-only verifies without writing. The diagnostics around it mislead (F-s07-10), a reused request_id is accepted, and a no-op status update commits a receipt and bumps revisions. Extra ledger-damage probes: losing both untracked ledgers lets a reused key commit a duplicate that nothing detects (F-s07-11).

consumer.goal: Submit the same capture twice with one idempotency key, once with a new key, and the same stage.progress.update twice; then probe key/request-id reuse
consumer.first_action: build + seal capture.create envelope (key idem-s21-k1) against bootstrap --brief snapshot

los capability capture.create (original k1 envelope after 2 later writes)
los capability stage.progress.update (new key s2, already paused)
los capability capture.create (request id req-s21-cap-1 reused, key k3)
los observe --help; grep docs for operations/observation
confusions: replayed result omits the inner 'ok' key and, for stage progress, the unit/stage/status fields the first response carried
every committed write is BLOCKED / needs_attention in `los operations`
consumer.outcome: Retrying a write is safe: duplicates never create a second note or receipt. Changing what a used key means is refused. The operation log tells the user that almost everything needs attention.

internal.transaction_behavior: idempotency ledger operations/transactions/idempotency.yaml keyed by idempotency_key; replay returns the stored transaction without handler execution
internal.approval_behavior: each envelope carries its own intent hash; reusing a key with a different intent → IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT 'idempotency key was already used for a different approved intent'
unexpected_writes: no-op stage.progress.update (paused→paused, new key) committed receipt transaction-20260925-125732-001: all three files byte-identical (sha before = after), snapshot unchanged, but study-map-os-l02 and unit-os-l02 revisions bumped 1→2
warnings_errors: UNCONFIRMED 'no committed receipt exists for this exact request' (--replay-only k4, expected)
internal.git_diff_stat: 3 files modified (study-map.yaml, unit.yaml, resume.yaml), 3 inbox files + 5 receipts + ledgers added
